title: Deferred icon transition and gesture-sensitive disable states
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Icon-only buttons and compact actions are showing harsh visual jumps when switching into loading or disabled states on touch devices. Gesture cancellation and press-hold interactions reveal icon-to-spinner transitions that cause layout shift and accidental re-triggers. Goal: Define a deterministic, accessible, and theme-aware pattern that defers icon transitions until press intent resolves, provides a gesture-sensitive disabled affordance (soft-disable vs hard-disable), and maps tokens for robust dark/high-contrast fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Icon-to-loading transition is deferred until tap/press is released or a 120ms threshold is exceeded to avoid flicker
Press-and-hold (long-press) preserves intent: showing a soft-disabled state during hold but only committing to hard-disable after server acknowledgement or explicit cancel
No layout shift: spinner overlays use composited transforms and fixed layout boxes; icon size preserved using token-based padding
Accessible announcements: screen readers are informed when action is in-progress via aria-live and element role changes
Theming: tokens exist for light, dark, and high-contrast with explicit fallbacks for spinner tint and icon contrast
Regression tests: visual snapshot tests added and a play-mode harness reproducing touch gestures are present
decision_log: 2025-11-05 - Design sync: prefer deferring visual swap to on-release with 120ms minimum to balance perceived latency and accidental flicker (agreed: 120ms).
2025-11-07 - Engineering feasibility: continuous batching of request may return before release; agreed to expose optimistic UI flag for critical fast-path actions.
2025-11-12 - Accessibility review: use aria-live polite + aria-disabled for non-interactive state; avoid removing button from tab order when soft-disabled.
notes: Trade-off: delaying spinner reduces jitter but increases chance of optimistic illusion if backend is very slow. Compensate with skeleton shimmer for bigger CTA patterns, but keep icon buttons lightweight.
Touch nuance: iOS 15+ has a distinct press feedback timeline; we should test on physical devices rather than only simulator.
Token mapping: introduce new tokens button.icon.size-preserve, button.icon.spinner-overlay-offset, token names to be added to theme contract docs.
implementation_notes: CSS: use will-change: transform and transform: translateZ(0) for overlay; spinner absolutely positioned inside preserved-width container
Animation: swap animation uses opacity fade (120ms) + scale subtle (0.98->1) and respects prefers-reduced-motion -> cross-fade only

JS: press lifecycle: onPointerDown -> start gesture timer (100ms); if pointerUp before threshold -> treat as quick tap and show deferred spinner on commit; if pointerHold beyond 400ms -> show soft-disabled visual (50% opacity, aria-describedby hint).
Tokens: map existing semantic tokens where possible (semantic.surface, semantic.on-surface, progress.spin-color) and add explicit fallbacks for high-contrast mode
API flag: opt-in data attribute data-optimize-fastpath=true to allow optimistic transitions for flows that must show immediate loading
Testing: add Playwright scenarios for touch gestures, Percy snapshots for light/dark/contrast, unit tests for state machine transitions
QA_plan: Manual device matrix: iOS Safari 15+, iOS Safari 17, Chrome Android latest, Pixel 5/6, Samsung One UI
Accessibility checklist: VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard-only interaction, screen-reader announcements checked
Visual regression: Percy baselines added under design-2025.11 branch; fail-on-diff threshold tightened for compact variants
Performance: measure first-frame latency for spinner insertion in telemetry dashboard (PR link)
review_feedback: PM (Nora Jensen): prefer an operator-visible toggle in Console to opt out of deferred transitions for critical flows
Engineering (Ivan Ortega): suggested moving gesture timer to runtime config to A/B test the threshold; created ENG-41022
Security (Lena Kim): no secrets involved; confirm that any telemetry uses hashed identifiers only
rollback_plan: Feature gated behind feature flag design.defer-icon-transition; if unexpected regressions reported, revert flag in Console and roll back CSS/JS from PR/12345. Notify customers subscribed to beta list within 24 hours.
changelog: Introduces deferred icon-to-spinner transitions, gesture-sensitive soft-disable visual, new tokens for spinner overlay offsets and icon-size preservation, and accessibility improvements (aria-live polite + aria-disabled patterns).
estimate_history: 2025-11-15: 6 points - increased after engineering found gesture edge cases
